design: annual fiscal-year debt growth (log), 1901+; ridge (lambda=1) walk-forward, one-year-ahead, min 40 training years; political features known ex ante

conclusion.interpretation: Political-control variables do not materially improve one-year-ahead debt-growth prediction over an autoregressive baseline; their value in this product is segmentation and historical interpretability, not forecasting power. This matches the economic prior: debt dynamics are driven by inherited budgets, economic conditions, and emergencies more than by party control alone.
conclusion.causalCaveat: None of this measures causation. Party control correlates with eras, wars, and business cycles that this design does not identify.
